news.title: Innovators Façade Systems Limited Announces Resignation of Shivchand Sharma as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Innovators Façade Systems Limited announced that Mr. Shivchand Sharma has tendered his resignation as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 23, 2026 along with his membership in various Committees, where he is a member due to his health conditions associated with aging.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 5 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Head of West Regional & Whole-Time Director Raman Sharma was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (6.8% average weekly change). Market cap is less than US$100m (₹3.57b market cap, or US$39.7m).

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.78 (vs ₹4.42 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.78 (down from ₹4.42 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹836.0m (down 27% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹52.4m (down 37% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 6.3% (down from 7.3% in 1H 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 30% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 50% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
